summary: Choosing a tab moves something. Raised by the maintainer ('the tabs only fade, and their change should rather indicate movement'); designed on the Tabs motion sheet first. One indicator per list (Base UI's Tabs.Indicator, placed from its --active-tab-* variables) carries the selected fill and slides to the new tab on --ui-duration-base with --ui-ease-out; its first placement never animates. While it is shown the tabs stop painting their own fill (a --tabs-selected-fill variable, so no class fights another); only the ink changes. A new panel enters --ui-space-sm x --ui-motion-travel from the side of the tab picked and fades in; the first panel on load does not animate. No blur (decided). At Reduced the indicator steps aside and each tab paints its own fill again; panels only fade. Static HTML is unchanged: before hydration the indicator is hidden and the tab paints its fill as before. Tests shown failing first; the panel tests were shown failing again with the entrance classes removed.
